bio_en: Gabriel Lazian was a senior ARF activist, photographed in 1938 with Dro in Lebanon and with Ruben in France. He spoke for the ARF Bureau at Sose Mayrik's funeral in Alexandria in 1953 and wrote on the Treaty of Sevres and Armenian territorial claims. Energetic to the end, he had recently visited Alexandria on party business, reporting for two hours on national and party questions. He died suddenly on a mountain in Lebanon in 1959.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Author of #69 and #380.
